customManagers.description: Append newly designated containerd LTS release lines
customManagers.autoReplaceStringTemplate:
"description": "Only update containerd to LTS release lines (https://github.com/containerd/containerd/blob/main/RELEASES.md#current-state-of-containerd-releases)",
      "matchPackageNames": ["containerd/containerd", "github.com/containerd/containerd", "github.com/containerd/containerd/v2"],
      "allowedVersions": "/^v?(?:{{{currentValue}}}|{{{newValue}}})\\.[0-9]+$/"
